key_insight: MedUIGym provides a testbed for clinical GUI agents, showing that current models struggle with EHR workflows while task-based training improves performance.
clinical_relevance: The platform supports research on EHR workflow automation but does not establish safety or effectiveness in clinical practice.
method: Unifies clinical tasks in an interactive EHR environment with screenshot-based mouse-and-keyboard control.
Pairs GUI and native-tool interfaces over identical clinical data, verifying answers and required actions.
Supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards.
evidence_signal: Evaluation spans 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families and 12 vision-language models; both trained Qwen3.5 models improved on in-domain tasks and generalized to external-source tasks.
watch_item: Benchmark gains do not establish reliable performance across real-world EHR systems or patient-care settings.
paper_title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
